01 / COUPLE STORY

River light.

A boat, an open sky, and an afternoon with nowhere else to be. A collection of quiet glances and easy laughter on the water.

The water gives these photographs their rhythm. Reflections, open space, and the warmth of red against the landscape carry the story.

Concept collection · sample photographs supplied with the project, not Joseph’s commissioned work.
